design.deduplication: Exact duplicate opponent pairs, identified by the unordered SHA-256 pair of warrior binaries, are represented once; the latest-year copy is preferred, and 2024 final2 replaces the 2024 online2 snapshot for the same team name.
design.balancing: Every opponent team appears once per panel; if needed, a small number of distinct teams is repeated only to fill complete three-opponent cohorts.
design.pairing: All four candidates face identical panel seeds and opponent groupings.
design.primaryMetric: Candidate team score per battle averaged over all included official team-pair opponents.

m049_minus_m050.interpretation: Exploratory paired score differences within shared 3-opponent cohorts. Opponent rows are contexts, not isolated duels or causal effects.

interpretation: Scores estimate average team points per battle when each candidate joins three teams sampled from the included unique historical code-pair pool and the four current zombies. They do not guarantee a single tournament outcome. Pairwise intervals use the 16 paired panel means; conservative familywise intervals use a deliberately high t multiplier for six comparisons. Context rows are exploratory shared-battle associations.
